title: Anthropic says Fable 5.1 will cost an estimated 25% less than Fable 5 for typical workloads and up to 45% less for highly agentic work (Rachel Metz/Bloomberg)
summary: Rachel Metz / Bloomberg: Anthropic says Fable 5.1 will cost an estimated 25% less than Fable 5 for typical workloads and up to 45% less for highly agentic work — Anthropic PBC is releasing a new version of its powerful Fable artificial intelligence model that it says is better at coding and science tasks …
